subject: rename git sha related (#184)
reason: The change is a pure symbol rename (redisGitSHA1/redisGitDirty/redisBuildId* -> serverGitSHA1/serverGitDirty/serverBuildId*) across release.c, server.h, server.c, cli_common.c and tls.c.
